description: Read Bible text for a reference such as "John 3:16", "Psalm 23" or "Romans 8:28-30". Returns the verses with book, chapter, verse number and text, plus the canonical reference. Available translations: BSB, WEB, KJV (default BSB); other translations are not available through this connector. Does NOT search by topic (use search_notes for the user's notes) and does NOT return cross-references (use get_cross_refs).

reference.description: Scripture reference in plain form: "John 3:16", "Psalm 23", "Rom 8:28-30", "1 Cor 13".

translation.description: Translation code. One of BSB, WEB, KJV. Defaults to BSB.

name: read_passage
title: Read passage
